visual.general_description: Grayscale coronal CT angiography image of the head, neck and upper chest with a yellow arrow and a red arrow near the base of the neck.
visual.detailed_description: Portrait-orientation grayscale coronal CT angiography reformat. The upper part shows the skull with bright bone, brain parenchyma and small bright intracranial vessels; the central column shows bright cervical vertebrae with bony structures at the skull base; the lower part shows the upper chest with both clavicles, ribs and dark lung regions at the lower corners. Near the base of the neck a yellow arrow points to the right toward a short bright vessel-like segment beside the vertebral column on the viewer left, and a red arrow points to the left toward a small round bright structure beside the vertebral column on the viewer right, with a very bright dense structure just below the red arrow. Thin bright linear structures run along the far left and far right image edges. Cropped viewer text is visible at the upper left (an orange partial word ending in nstruction followed by a small downward caret, and a single letter below it) and at the upper right (partial text reading C=212,0, W= cut off at the edge). No panel letters, scale bar or side markers are visible.

visual.general_description: Grayscale coronal MR angiography image of the neck showing several bright tubular vessels on either side of the cervical spine.
visual.detailed_description: Landscape-orientation grayscale coronal MR angiography image of the neck. A central dark column of vertebral bodies with gray horizontal disc-level bands lies in the middle. Smooth bright tubular vessels run vertically: two thick bright vessels at the upper left and upper right of the image lateral to the spine, a long thin bright vessel curving on the viewer left of the spine through the lower half, and a thicker bright vessel on the viewer right of the spine running from the upper middle to the lower edge, with a few short bright branches near the upper corners. Dark soft tissue and dark outer regions surround them, with thin black bars at the top and bottom edges. No arrows, panel letters, scale bar, side markers or text are visible.
